capabilities: Author quiz questions as numbered markdown checkbox lists in any note
Run timed, scored exams with custom scoring formulas and strict mode
Pull questions from named notes, folders, or previously applied tags
Schedule question review with an SM-2 spaced repetition system
Track exam history in an analytics dashboard and export results to notes
extras: Installation is manual: users must download main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run interactive, scored exams or quizzes from question lists stored in notes.
summary: Quiz engine that turns markdown checkbox question banks into interactive exams with scoring, timers, tagging, spaced repetition and an analytics dashboard.
